name: @ci/capacitor-local-hub
description: Capacitor plugin for the on-device Local Hub: a loopback-only embedded HTTP server hosting a durable SQLite capture outbox, and later local llama.cpp inference plus the same read endpoints CI-Server's memory domain exposes. Today: start()/stop()/getStatus(), a bearer-authenticated GET /api/health, and the /api/outbox routes -- see README.md. Unlike @ci/capacitor-local-llm (Android-only), this plugin ships both Android and iOS native implementations.
